newsitem.title: INDIA: INDIA'S CARE DOWNGRADES ITS RATING OF PCML.
newsitem.headline: INDIA'S CARE DOWNGRADES ITS RATING OF PCML.

text.p: Credit Analysis & Research Ltd.(CARE) said on Thursday in a statement that it has downgraded its rating for the Fixed Deposit programme of Prudential Capital Markets Limited (PCML) from CARE BBB(FD) under Credit Watch to CARE BB(FD).
Instruments with Double B rating are considered to be speculative, with inadequate protection for interest and principal payments.

PCML has declared its intention to close down its financial services activities, as they are no longer considered viable. It has also announced that it would not be accepting fresh deposits. With this, its liquidity position is expected to remain under pressure.
